title: Kestrel and the Alibi Again
author: August Blackwood
blurb: Lior Amberdale, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
